name: plans-picker
description: Pricing v2 plans section: centred heading, a 'how many records' chip picker that flags the plan that fits, a row of plan cards (one may be featured), and a 'what counts as a record' strip. Source: the Asset Panda Pricing v2 mockup.

section_id.description: Section id, so buttons elsewhere can link to #plans.

variant.description: classic: the mockup's look. clean: white page, segmented picker, the first plan as a wide card above the rest, quieter cards.

heading_level.description: h1 when this section opens the page (its heading is then the page heading).

notice_label.description: Bold start of an internal notice above the heading, e.g. INTERNAL DRAFT. Shows only when this or notice is set.

notice.description: Rest of the internal notice, e.g. Provisional pricing, not approved for publication.

art.description: Illustration beside the heading (centred above it below 1024px): a URL, or a file name in this component's assets folder, e.g. panda-ursa.webp.

art_alt.description: Alt text for the illustration. Empty marks it decorative.

art_width.description: Illustration's intrinsic width in px (reserves its space while it loads). 0 leaves it out.

compare_label.description: Link at the foot of every card, e.g. See all features. Shows only with compare_url.

compare_url.description: Where that link goes, e.g. #compare (the plans-compare section).

eyebrow.description: Small purple label above the heading.

title.description: First heading line. Empty when another section (e.g. plans-hero split) carries the page heading.

lead_position.description: Where the first plan (the entry plan, a wide card in the clean variant) sits: before the others or after them. none: no lead card, every plan is an ordinary card (clean: five across).

head_style.description: hero: the heading, question, chips and answer line sit in a full-width banner on the hero art (use it when this section opens the page); the cards follow on white. plain: everything on the section background.

hero_background.description: Banner art for head_style hero: a URL, or a file name in this component's assets folder (hero-bg.webp = the homepage hero gradient).

title_accent.description: Second heading line, set in the brand gradient.

chips.description: Picker chips. Each: label (chip text), plan (the plan name it points at), note (text after the bold plan name in the answer line, e.g. fits: $39/mo, 500 records, unlimited users.).

default_plan.description: Plan picked when the page loads (its chip pressed, its card tagged, the answer line filled), e.g. Growth. Empty starts with nothing picked.

hint.description: Answer line before a chip is picked.

fit_label.description: Tag shown on the card the picker points at.

plans.description: Plan cards, in order. Each: name, who (one-line audience), price, price_suffix (e.g. /mo), per (line under the price), annual (purple line), cta_label, cta_url, records, records_label, plus (e.g. Everything in Free, plus), includes (one feature per line), flag (e.g. Most popular; a flagged card is the featured one).

counts_label.description: Label over the list of things that count.

counts.description: Things that count as a record, one per line.

never_label.description: Label over the list of things that never count.

never.description: Things that never count, one per line.
